ttm_diagnostics.note: Mechanical FCF = OCF minus PPE purchases. FCF-minus-SBC subtracts income-statement SBC once as a conservative owner-cash diagnostic; capitalized SBC is not separately re-subtracted before inventory/amortization tracing, avoiding double counting. Neither metric is a company-defined non-GAAP measure.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain the 2026-09-06 base owner-margin path and 25x terminal multiple; hold year-1 revenue at $13.2B and solve a uniform revenue-growth rate for years 2-10 at a 9% required return. This is not a unique observable market belief.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: Approximately 12.56% annual growth is demanding but not an obviously impossible bull-case requirement given current procedure and revenue growth. The valuation remains highly sensitive to owner margin, competition, lease capital intensity and terminal assumptions.

bear.narrative: Procedure growth decelerates, credible competitors take share or force pricing concessions, recent product-quality issues become more economically relevant, and leasing/capital needs dilute cash conversion.

base.narrative: Da Vinci 5, Ion and geographic adoption sustain low-to-mid teens procedure economics initially, recurring instrument/service economics remain strong, and competition broadens the market without materially impairing Intuitive's installed-base flywheel.

bull.narrative: Da Vinci 5 adoption and feedback features expand procedure categories and utilization, Ion scales internationally, competition validates category growth more than it erodes share, and operating leverage offsets tariffs and lease capital intensity.

two_state_price_position.note: This is not an estimated probability; it only locates the current price between two modeled endpoints.

liquidity_note: Cash, cash equivalents and investments of approximately $8.63B materially strengthen survivability. To preserve comparability with the existing 2026-09-06 scenario architecture, this checkpoint does not separately add all liquidity to the scenario PV as if every dollar were immediately distributable excess cash.
valuation_conclusion: Current price is about 16.7% above the retained base intrinsic-value estimate and implies roughly 12.56% annual growth under the retained base economics. Price does not require an obviously unrealistic bull case, but there is not yet a sufficient base-case margin of safety for a harness buy authorization.
